At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.
Job Overview
We're looking for a Marketing Creative Director to lead campaign creative across the Hasbro toys portfolio. In this role, you'll build how our brands show up in the world, from global product launches and retail moments to video content, digital, and social. You'll elevate our creative standards, unlock breakthrough ideas, and connect beloved brands with the kids, fans, and grown-ups who love them. And of course, have a lot of fun doing it!
You will guide the creative vision, storytelling, and visual elements across a portfolio that includes preschool, action, collector, adult, and family play. You will be supported by internal teams of copywriters, designers, art directors, and partner with product marketing teams and toy studios to develop groundbreaking campaign platforms and launch new products and characters.
This creative leadership role requires hands-on involvement, combining a strong understanding of how to inspire kids and kidults with visual and storytelling craftsmanship. It values a true appreciation of how toys are played with and a solid grasp of business aspects. The ideal candidate has directed creative campaigns for consumer, entertainment, or brand-based products. They shift easily from big-picture ideas to detailed actions, addressing retail needs, out of home, packaging placement, and global market variations. You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing Creative to ensure our brands keep innovating while staying true to what makes them endure.
Location and Work Arrangement
This role is based at our Boston, Massachusetts, United States office and follows a hybrid schedule designed to support in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work onsite on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or onsite on Mondays and Fridays.
What You'll Do
Take charge of the creative development and delivery of toy and game marketing, encompassing campaign platforms, launch assets, video, retail, and digital creative.
Collaborate with brand and product marketing leads to translate strategy into emotionally resonant, data-driven creative.
Mentor and guide teams of internal creatives, helping them grow, complete work at a high level, and stay encouraged.
Set and uphold the creative standard across all work, whether it's a global brand film or a single social post.
Work with product development, development services, and licensing teams to uncover storytelling opportunities in each launch and maintain consistent brand expression from ad to package to shelf.
Guide and encourage external agency partners and vendors, ensuring alignment to each brand's tone, visual identity, and audience.
Balance the demands of a multi-brand portfolio, prioritizing effort, sequencing work, and knowing where a distinct brand voice matters versus where scale and system win.
Represent creative in key meetings, working closely with senior leadership across the business.
What You'll Bring
10+ years of creative experience in brand or campaign work for consumer products, toys, entertainment, or organizations centered around intellectual property.
5+ years leading internal and external creative teams with a track record of strong mentorship and collaborative leadership.
Demonstrated ability to create visual storytelling and audience-first creative for long-standing consumer brands.
Outstanding concepting, campaign development, and narrative instincts.
Comfortable working across multiple brands and audience segments at once, from preschool to adult collector.
Ability to clearly communicate and present ideas to senior customers and collaborators.
A portfolio that showcases variety, creativity, and a strong grasp of how to engage audiences through creatively inspiring work.
Who We Are
We’re a team of creators, storytellers, and innovators united under the Hasbro family and home to beloved brands, AAA digital games studios and immersive experiences that spark imagination across generations. Together, we’re committed to a culture rooted in creativity, excellence, curiosity, and inclusion, and where every employee is empowered to think boldly, act with integrity, and spark joy for all.

Job Overview
We are seeking a Sr. Creative Director, Brand Experience to lead the creative vision, development and stewardship of Hasbro’s iconic portfolio of toy and game brands across Action, Fashion, Preschool, Nerf, Play-Doh and Board Games. This leader will shape how our brands show up in the world; building distinctive creative platforms and identities that connect with consumers, stand out in culture and drive commercial impact.
Leading our front-end Brand Experience organization, you will set the creative vision for the portfolio and build the teams, standards and tools needed to bring that vision to life globally. You’ll partner closely with Brand Marketing, Product Design & Development, Commercial, Licensing and our Global Creative Studio to connect brand strategy to execution across every consumer touchpoint. The mandate is simple: build brands that cut through the noise and move with culture.
Location and Work Arrangement
Hybrid:
 This role is based at our Boston, Massachusetts office and follows a hybrid schedule designed to support in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work onsite on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or onsite on Mondays and Fridays.
What You'll Do
• Set the creative vision for our toys and board games portfolio. Translating business, brand and commercial strategies into distinctive creative platforms that can scale globally.
• Own brand creative strategy across Action, Fashion, Preschool, Nerf, Play-Doh and Board Games, ensuring each brand has a differentiated and culturally relevant expression.
• Lead the front-end of brand development, including brand creative strategy, creative direction, visual and verbal identity, brand guidelines and creative toolkits.
• Build brands, not just campaigns. Establish enduring creative systems that strengthen brand equity while creating the flexibility to stay relevant across audiences and channels.
• Champion consumer and cultural insight as a creative catalyst. Ensure our creative work starts with a deep understanding of the audiences we serve.
• Partner with cross-functional partners to ensure brand vision translates with excellence across packaging, retail, digital, social, licensing and entertainment.
• Raise the creative bar. Establish clear standards for creative excellence and continually challenge our teams and partners to push beyond category conventions and the expected.
• Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing brand creative team with a culture of ambition, curiosity, collaboration and accountability.
• Influence at the highest levels of the organization, advocating for creative vision with senior leaders and bringing stakeholders along through clear, persuasive storytelling.
• Shape the future of creative at Hasbro, embracing emerging technology, AI and new modes of storytelling to evolve how we build brands and connect with consumers.
What You'll Bring
• 15+ years of progressive creative leadership experience within world-class consumer brands, creative agencies or similarly complex brand environments.
• Experience leading multi-brand portfolios and building distinctive brands that live across both commerce and culture.
• A body of work that demonstrates strategic thinking and measurable brand impact, not just great execution.
• Deep expertise in brand building, creative strategy, creative direction, visual and verbal identity and integrated brand systems.
• Fluency across channels, with a strong understanding of how brand ideas translate across physical, digital, social, retail, experiential and emerging consumer experiences.
• Proven experience building, leading and developing senior creative talent and multidisciplinary teams.
• Exceptional ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional partners while protecting the integrity and ambition of the creative vision.
• The ability to balance big creative ambition with commercial reality, knowing where to push, where to simplify and how to turn strategy into action.
• A strong point of view on culture, consumers, technology and the changing creative landscape, including the opportunities presented by AI and new forms of creative expression.
• Experience in toys, games, entertainment, CPG or brands that live at the intersection of retail, fandom and culture is a major plus.
• A positive, low-ego leadership style with a bias toward action and a genuine desire to make both the work and the people around you better.
Who We Are
We’re a team of creators, storytellers, and innovators united under the Hasbro family and home to beloved brands, AAA digital games studios and immersive experiences that spark imagination across generations. 우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다. 
Partnerships Team은 KRAFTON과 외부 파트너를 연결하는 전사 레벨 기능 조직입니다. 개별 스튜디오나 사업 조직의 범위를 넘어, 회사 전체 관점에서 파트너 관계를 만들고 운영합니다.
팀 단위 업무는 크게 세 개의 축으로 나뉩니다. 게임 유통 채널을 다루는 Platform, 게임의 제작 및 구동과 엮이는 Tech, 그리고 게임과 비게임 영역의 이니셔티브를 다루는 Strategy입니다. 하나의 파트너사가 주제에 따라 여러 축에 걸치는 경우도 있습니다.
팀은 회사의 다양한 사업 주제와 파트너사의 방향이 만나는 지점을 찾아 협업 구조로 만들고, 내부 여러 조직이 필요로 하는 자원과 협상 레버리지를 전사 차원에서 확보합니다. 동시에 특정 파트너나 기술에 대한 의존성처럼 회사 전체에 영향을 주는 구조적 리스크를 짚고, 당사가 장기적인 기회와 선택지를 가질 수 있도록 준비합니다.
 
우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.
본 포지션은 Tech 축을 리딩합니다. 게임엔진, AI, 반도체와 하드웨어, 클라우드 등 게임의 개발부터 서비스 단계의 여러 과정에 관련된 업체들과 파트너 관계를 열고 유지하고, 딜의 구조를 설계하며, 실행 단계에서도 파트너사 창구로서 각 실무조직과 함께 과제를 관리합니다. 예를 들어 아래와 같은 업무를 리딩합니다.

복수 파트너사로부터 최적의 조건을 이끌어내고, 스튜디오 및 퍼블리싱 조직과 의사결정 조율
공동개발 지원, 마케팅 자금, 기술 지원 등 파트너사의 예산과 프로그램을 회사로 인입할 수 있는 기회 발굴
기술 적용에 연계된 공동 마케팅 기회를 확보하고, 관련 조직과 함께 협의

여러 타이틀과 조직에 걸친 계약들이 서로 어떻게 맞물리는지, 장기 커밋먼트와 비용 구조, 기술 의존성을 회사 관점에서 파악하고 관리
기술 파트너사와의 라이선스 및 기술지원 계약 협상 (법무, 재무, 구매 등 유관 조직과 협업)
